text:
kai: morning team — stuck on Okta. SMS MFA is wired to my old UK number (+44...) and I can't receive codes. Okta won't let me enroll a passkey because device trust requires MFA. 1Password shows 'no access' and I can't reach the onboarding Drive or the private dataset. who can update my phone or give a short-term workaround?
devon-peopleops: hi @kai, welcome! sorry for the friction. please DM me the new verified number and i'll update your directory alias and reissue the invite. i'll also add a temporary 1Password seat and enable passkey enrollment for you in the meantime. :wave:
ash-eng: if you need the dataset now we can provision ephemeral VPN creds or a temporary S3 read role + readonly SQL user. vpn-bot can create a short-lived token. DM me if you prefer SSH access to the bastion instead.
kai: DM'd the number. i'd prefer passkey over a rotated password. for the dataset I need S3 read and an analytics read-only DB user for the onboarding workbook.
security: passkeys are allowed temporarily for new hires until hardware MFA arrives, provided device inventory is recorded and full-disk encryption is enabled. @kai please enable FileVault/BitLocker and DM device model + OS build for our inventory.
vpn-bot: ephemeral access created: token id vpn-ephemeral-9f2a. Use:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://vpn.redwood.ai/connect
Token expiry: 12h. Ticket VPN-8891 created for audit.
it-bot: created ticket ONB-90877 for phone update + 1Password seat. Assigned to people-ops. ETA 20m.
devon-peopleops: 1Password seat added at 2805000020. After i add it, wait ~2-5m then try `op signin`. i'll also mark your Okta profile to allow platform passkeys.
kai: got the seat notification but `op signin` still errors with "account not provisioned". any quick fixes?
ash-eng: try in this order:
```
op account add --team-url https://redwood.1password.com
op signin redwood
```
also if SSO looks stuck, try an incognito window to clear SSO cookies or confirm system clock is correct.
kai: ran those exact commands and `op signin` succeeded  thanks! enrolled a platform passkey and VPN token connected. S3 read and analytics DB access work.
devon-peopleops: perfect. yubikey shipped; tracking DM sent. i'll permanently update your phone on the directory after you confirm the DM. welcome aboard @kai :tada:
it-bot: ONB-90877 resolved at 2805000050. VPN-8891 closed.
